0.headline: Tonbo Imaging IPO GMP at 67% ahead of listing tomorrow; check key details here
0.heading: Tonbo Imaging IPO GMP at 67% ahead of listing tomorrow; check key details here
0.intro: Tonbo Imaging India shares are commanding a strong grey market premium (GMP) ahead of their listing on the stock exchanges on October 23, with the defence technology company's IPO attracting heavy investor demand.
0.body:
Tonbo Imaging India shares are commanding a strong grey market premium (GMP) ahead of their listing on the stock exchanges on October 23, after the defence technology company's IPO attracted heavy investor demand during the bidding period.

According to InvestorGain, Tonbo Imaging shares were commanding a grey market premium of nearly 67 percent on the morning of October 22.

However, the grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and does not guarantee listing gains. The actual listing price may differ from these estimates.

Read Also: From selling raincoats to Rs 150-crore 'Ideal Ice Cream': How Prabhakar Kamath built Mangaluru's popular ice cream brand

The Rs 852.18-crore IPO closed for subscription on October 19, attracting bids for 1,15,86,91,464 shares against 85,26,033 shares on offer. The issue was subscribed 135.9 times, according to data from the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

The IPO witnessed strong demand across all investor categories. The Qualified Institutional Buyers (QIBs) portion was subscribed 293.56 times, while the Non-Institutional Investors (NIIs) category saw 170.94 times subscription. The Retail Individual Investors (RIIs) portion was subscribed 31.06 times.

The company had fixed the IPO price band at Rs 665-700 per share. The lot size was 21 shares, requiring a minimum investment of Rs 14,700 for retail investors applying at the upper end of the price band.

The public issue comprised an offer for sale (OFS) of 1,21,74,046 equity shares, with no fresh issue component. At the upper end of the price band, the issue was valued at Rs 852.18 crore, implying a market capitalisation of around Rs 4,010 crore.

Since the IPO is entirely an OFS, Tonbo Imaging India will not receive any proceeds from the share sale. Instead, the proceeds, after applicable expenses, will go to the existing shareholders selling their stakes.

Check IPO News Here

Promoters Arvind Kondangi Lakshmikumar, Ankit Kumar and Cecilia D'Souza, along with existing investors including CEAQ Technologies, Timothy Guy Mitchell, Artiman Partners LLC and Ramesh Radhakrishnan, are among the shareholders offloading their holdings.

JM Financial and IIFL Capital Services are the book-running lead managers for the issue, while KFin Technologies is the registrar.

About Tonbo Imaging India

Incorporated in 2003, Tonbo Imaging India designs and manufactures electro-optic and electronic systems for defence applications.

Its product portfolio includes thermal imaging systems, weapon sights, handheld thermal imaging binoculars, targeting systems, missile seekers, fire-control systems and missile-guidance systems. The company's technologies are used in surveillance, reconnaissance, targeting and other military applications.

1.headline: Paras Healthcare IPO subscribed 19% so far on Day 2; retail investors lead demand
1.heading: Paras Healthcare IPO subscribed 19% so far on Day 2; retail investors lead demand
1.intro: The initial public offering (IPO) for Paras Healthcare opened for subscription today, with the issue receiving 19 percent subscription by 10:30 am on October 22, as per NSE data.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) for Paras Healthcare opened for subscription today, with the issue receiving 19 percent subscription by 10:30 am on October 22, as per NSE data.

The Rs 1,450-crore IPO received bids for 22,54,770 shares against 1,20,83,331 shares on offer. Retail investors led the demand, subscribing to 88 percent of their allotted portion, while the non-institutional investor (NII) category was subscribed 10 percent.

In the grey market, the Paras Healthcare IPO was commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of Rs 25 per share on the morning of October 22, as per Investorgain. Based on the upper end of the IPO price band of Rs 693, the premium indicated a potential listing gain of around 3.6 percent, taking the implied listing price to approximately Rs 718 per share.

Read Also: Fusion CX shares list at 5.5% premium on NSE — should you buy, sell or hold?

The grey market premium is an unofficial indicator of investor sentiment and is based on transactions outside the regulated stock exchanges. It is not a guarantee of listing performance, and the premium can fluctuate before the shares make their stock market debut.

The Paras Healthcare IPO will remain open for public subscription from October 21 to October 23. The company has fixed the price band at Rs 660–693 per share.

The public issue comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 500 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of Rs 950 crore, taking the total issue size to Rs 1,450 crore.

Under the OFS, promoter Dharminder Kumar Nagar will sell shares worth Rs 300 crore, while Commelina, an affiliate of private equity firm Creador, will offload shares worth Rs 650 crore.

Ahead of the IPO, Paras Healthcare raised Rs 652.5 crore through its anchor book. The company allotted 94.15 lakh equity shares to 21 institutional investors on Monday.

Global investors participating in the anchor book included the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, BlackRock Global Funds, Eastspring Investments, Government Pension Fund Global, Natixis International Funds, Integrated Core Strategies (Asia) and Citigroup Global.

Paras Healthcare plans to utilise Rs 375 crore from the net proceeds of the fresh issue to repay a portion of its outstanding debt. The remaining proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes.

Check IPO News Here

The IPO proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, while the OFS component will be received by the selling shareholders.

Paras Healthcare provides tertiary and quaternary healthcare services through a network of eight hospitals operating under the Paras brand. The hospitals have a combined capacity of 2,211 beds across North India, Bihar and Jharkhand.

As part of its expansion strategy, the company plans to add a 300-bed hospital in Gurugram and a 500-bed facility in Ludhiana. The two hospitals are expected to become operational in the current and next financial years, respectively.

The expansion is aimed at increasing the company's hospital capacity and strengthening its presence in key healthcare markets.

JM Financial, BofA Securities India and Nuvama Wealth Management are the merchant bankers to the Paras Healthcare IPO.

2.headline: Fusion CX shares list at 5.5% premium on NSE — should you buy, sell or hold?
2.heading: Fusion CX shares list at 5.5% premium on NSE — should you buy, sell or hold?
2.intro: Shares of Fusion CX made a positive debut on the stock exchanges on October 22, listing at a premium of 5.54 percent on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) over the initial public offering (IPO) price.
2.body:
Shares of Fusion CX made a positive debut on the stock exchanges on October 22, listing at a premium of 5.54 percent on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) over the initial public offering (IPO) price.

The stock listed at Rs 305 on the NSE against the issue price of Rs 289 per share. On the BSE, Fusion CX shares debuted at Rs 292, marking a premium of 1.04 percent over the IPO price.

Following the listing, the company's market capitalisation stood at around Rs 4,215.32 crore.

Read Also: From selling raincoats to Rs 150-crore 'Ideal Ice Cream': How Prabhakar Kamath built Mangaluru's popular ice cream brand

The listing was broadly in line with grey market expectations. The grey market premium (GMP) had indicated a potential listing gain of nearly 5% on the morning of October 22, according to InvestorGain. However, GMP is an unofficial indicator of market sentiment and does not guarantee the actual listing price or investor returns.

The Rs 702-crore IPO of Fusion CX received bids for 6,24,63,831 shares against 1,40,40,000 shares on offer, translating into an overall subscription of 4.45 times.

Retail investors led the demand, subscribing to their portion 5.70 times. The non-institutional investor (NII) category was subscribed 4.50 times.

The IPO comprised a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 500 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 69.90 lakh shares worth Rs 202 crore. While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS will allow existing shareholders to sell part of their holdings.

Fusion CX had fixed the IPO price band at Rs 275-289 per share. Retail investors could apply for a minimum of 51 shares, requiring an investment of Rs 14,739 at the upper end of the price band.

Check IPO News Here

Fusion CX plans to use a portion of the proceeds from the fresh issue to repay or prepay certain outstanding borrowings of the company and its subsidiaries, including select step-down subsidiaries.

The company also intends to invest in its step-down subsidiaries, Omind Technologies Inc. and Omind Technologies Private Limited, to upgrade its information technology tools, including Arya and MindVoice.

The proposed investments are aimed at strengthening its technology capabilities and operational infrastructure as it expands its customer experience solutions.

Should you buy, sell or hold?

Mahesh M. Ojha, Vice President, Research and Business Development at Kantilal Chhaganlal Securities Pvt Ltd. said, "Allotted investors can book partial listing gains; the remaining can be held for the long term ."

Another analyst, Sarvam Goel, founder of Pocketful said, "Investors who received allotment can hold and track execution. Those who missed the IPO can watch the business closely, as a good entry opportunity could emerge post-listing."

About Fusion CX

Incorporated in 2004, Fusion CX is a technology-driven customer experience (CX) solutions provider offering multilingual services across voice, chat, email, social media and messaging platforms.

Its services include customer acquisition, customer support, collections, customer retention and technical assistance, along with digital solutions.

Through its technology subsidiary, Omind Technologies, Fusion CX also develops artificial intelligence-powered tools for customer engagement, marketing, quality automation and workforce management.
